pattern.description: The previous agent reply gains a divider and an 'Order arriving at 2pm' status chip, then the thread scrolls up and a second agent bubble grows out of a small pill with its avatar orb popping in; its text starts word by word ('Your order') in sync with the voice.
pattern.why_premium: Structured data (the status chip) is appended to the conversational reply rather than shown as plain text, and the next bubble is born from a typing pill, so the chat feels live and tool-backed while speech and text stay locked.

build_hint.gsap: tl.fromTo('.reply-1 .divider', {scaleX: 0}, {scaleX: 1, transformOrigin: 'left', duration: 0.2, ease: 'power2.out'}).fromTo('.reply-1 .status', {opacity: 0, y: 4}, {opacity: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.2}, '<'); tl.to('.thread', {y: -100, duration: 0.4, ease: 'power2.inOut'}); tl.fromTo('.reply-2', {width: 32, height: 20, opacity: 0}, {opacity: 1, width: 380, height: 150, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power3.out'}, '<0.15').fromTo('.reply-2 .orb', {scale: 0}, {scale: 1, duration: 0.2, ease: 'back.out(1.4)'}, '<'); words fade in at narration timestamps.
build_hint.remotion: Divider scaleX and status opacity via interpolate over 6 frames; thread translateY spring({damping: 200}); new bubble width/height spring({damping: 22, stiffness: 180}) from pill size; orb scale spring; reply words keyed to word start frames.

notes: Camera verdict tilt_down (pan_y -0.14) but it reads as the chat thread scrolling; the status chip appears at the very start of the burst and could alternatively be its own chip_append beat.
